_notes.player: "auto" tries paplay, pw-play, ffplay, aplay, mpv. Or give an argv list; the .wav file path is appended as the last arg, e.g. ["mpv", "--no-video", "--really-quiet"]
_notes.clipboard_cmd: "auto" tries wl-paste / xclip / xsel / pbpaste. Used only when a keybound speak arrives with no text (herdr doesn't pass the selection to keybindings; copy_on_select keeps the clipboard = last selection). Or an argv list that prints the clipboard to stdout.
_notes.synth_cmd: engine=command only: argv that takes text on stdin and writes a WAV to stdout; it's captured to a temp file and played with `player`
_notes.ssh_host: must be reachable non-interactively (key auth). Test: ssh my-herdr-host true
_notes.tail_cmd: advanced/testing: full argv that streams spool lines to stdout, replacing the built-in ssh+tail
